chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him): When he appointed Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr [as governor of] Egypt,
ai.seo_question: What happened to Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr after Imam Ali appointed him governor of Egypt?
ai.summary: This narration marks the pivotal moment when Imam Ali appointed Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr, his cousin and close companion, to govern Egypt, a strategic province contested by the Umayyads. The subsequent loss of Egypt and the martyrdom of Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr underscore the political instability and military challenges faced during the Imamate, highlighting the transition from the Rashidun era to the rise of the Umayyad dynasty.

en.sayed-ali-raza: When Amīr al-mu’minīn appointed Muḥammad ibn Abi Bakr [1] Governor of Egypt
